name: resource-monitor
description: CPU and memory of Claude Code and the processes it starts: a Resources pane with sparklines, a status-line readout, warning colours, and a tool so Claude can answer about it

cpuWarn.title: CPU warning (% of the machine)
cpuWarn.description: Figures turn red at this share of the whole machine's CPU (yellow from 80% of it).

memWarn.title: Memory warning (% of RAM)
memWarn.description: Figures turn red when Claude Code's processes use this share of RAM (yellow from 80% of it).

intervalSeconds.title: Sample every (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often to sample. Each sample runs the system's process listing, so very short intervals cost CPU themselves.

statusLine.title: Show CPU and memory in the status line
statusLine.description: Show a compact CPU and memory readout in the status line.

autoOpen.title: Open the Resources pane at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the Resources pane when a session starts. /resources opens it any time.

injectContext.title: Tell Claude what's running
injectContext.description: Beside your prompt, tell Claude which processes it has running and any warning, only when that changes.
